versions.content: The Format of the IPv6 SD Endpoint Option shall be as follows: • Length [uint16]: Shall be set to 0x0015. • Type [uint8]: Shall be set to 0x26. • Reserved [uint8]: Shall be set to 0x00. • IPv6-Address [uint128]: Shall transport the unicast IP-Address of SOME/IP-SD as 16 Bytes. • Reserved [uint8]: Shall be set to 0x00. • Transport Protocol (L4-Proto) [uint8]: Shall be set to the transport layer protocol of SOME/IP-SD (currently: 0x11 UDP). • Transport Protocol Port Number (L4-Port) [uint16]: Shall be set to the transport layer port of SOME/IP-SD (e.g. 30490).
